decisive_join: Join pre-application self-selection, network access, cultural matching, credential proxies, persona-construction skill, constructed criteria, and insider self-validation without converting structural analysis into an individual desert verdict.

findings.claim: Privilege in the seed includes interface literacy: knowing how corporate questions, credentials, demeanor, and trait language are coded.
limits: Distribution by class, race, disability, geography, and industry remains to be measured.

findings.claim: Selection can become self-validating when insiders receive the opportunities that generate performance evidence and later author the next selector.
limits: The mechanism does not establish that every insider is unqualified or every achievement is reducible to privilege.

findings.claim: The seed does not support an individual moral ranking of successful applicants or a claim that all persona management is deception.
limits: Candidate adaptation, coaching, contextual self-presentation, and dishonesty are distinct objects.

observations.notes: The seed treats the applicant pool as already selected before formal screening.
observations.subject: job advertisement language
observations.value: wording can alter perceived belonging and application interest

observations.notes: The seed refuses to treat the formal applicant denominator as the whole eligible population.
observations.subject: referral networks
observations.value: matching benefits can coexist with homophily, immobility, and exclusion from incumbent networks

observations.notes: The seed presents culture as part of the construction of merit rather than a neutral afterthought.
observations.subject: elite professional-service hiring

observations.notes: Administratively legible signals can carry class and racial information.
observations.subject: credentials and names

observations.notes: This does not establish that every high score is dishonest.
observations.subject: high-stakes personality testing
observations.value: actual applicants report more socially desirable trait profiles and may infer the desired role persona

observations.notes: The seed treats precommitment as a control against post-hoc rationalization.
observations.subject: evaluator criteria
observations.value: merit criteria can be reconstructed around a preferred candidate unless committed in advance

observations.notes: The seed names the resulting defense petulant privilege while preserving the need not to erase genuine achievement.
observations.subject: successful insiders

selection_rule: Separate measurable access and evaluation mechanisms from moral claims about any named insider; preserve criteria, precommitment, coaching exposure, and opportunity allocation.

prohibited_inferences: absence from an applicant pool proves lack of interest
culture fit is always irrelevant to work

title: Privilege and persona construction: the system selects its own validators
